SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 14.4.1 Class reader: Features of style, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we convey a message more effectively? 2. Why do we use similes and metaphors?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 14.4.1 Class reader: Features of style together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: A learner holds a discussion on instances in real life where dialogues, similes, and metaphors can be

used, thereby enhancing their literary skills.

● Learning to learn: A learner records and share videos.

Values:
Respect: A learner helps each other during role-play of selected dialogues.
